construction: 46 placements in 24 steps plus child sections (87 parts in all). Steps 1–9: a core in yellow, black, blue and olive: plates 2×2×⅔ with two side studs, bricks 1×4 with side studs, brackets and a hinge base (step 9). Steps 10–24: the white shell: curved panels and children (`433` is hinged on the hinge base), a locking hinge plate (step 15), wedges, and a wheel rim and child `444` as engine bells.
interfaces: The parent places it with matrix `0 -0.707 0.707 / 0 0.707 0.707 / -1 0 0`: on its side and turned 45°.
lesson: A colour-coded SNOT core carries a hinged white shell. For thick, layered SNOT, source steps explain more than transparency.
parent_context: One rear OMS engine pod beside the tail of `10283 - shuttle.ldr`.
reuse_notes: Build the core in contrasting colours: it makes each SNOT direction obvious while building. Hinge a shell panel where the shape must close over a curve.
